cells.quote: Summative assessments indicated a significantly improved mean score (18.1 ± 4.5 vs 20.3 ± 4.9, p = 0.002); partly attributed to enhanced knowledge of myocardial hypertrophy and pressure–velocity differences over a stenotic valve.
